title: Before Pakistan Could Recover From Indus Waters Treaty Blow, India Unleashes New Hydropower Project On Chenab River
description: After suspending the Indus Waters Treaty, India takes another strategic step with a new hydroelectric project on the Chenab River, signaling firm control over its water resources.

title: Trump, back on the scoreboard, claims he stopped India-Pakistan conflict and ‘solved eight wars’
description: US President Donald Trump again claimed credit for stopping India–Pakistan conflict. India rejected mediation, saying ceasefire followed direct DGMO talks.

title: ‘Do I Get Credit For It? I Solved Eight Wars, How About India And Pakistan?’: Trump’s Hot Mic Moment On Nobel Snub During Netanyahu Meeting Goes Viral
description: During a sit down with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, former President Donald Trump was overheard on a microphone saying he had ‘solved eight wars’ including the one between India and Pakistan and complaining that he had not been given credit for it. Trump's off the cuff remarks, which included a discussion on his feeling of being overlooked for the Nobel Peace Prize, went viral almost instantly on different social networks and elicited various responses.

title: India rejects Pak's remarks, points out its 'abysmal record' on minorities
description: India on Monday strongly rejected remarks by Pakistan’s ministry of foreign affairs on incidents involving minorities in India, saying comments from a country with a “horrific and systemic” record of persecuting minorities lacked credibility.

title: Trump’s hot mic moment: Nobel snub, India-Pakistan claims aired before Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago
description: A hot mic caught US President Donald Trump lamenting to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu about him not being given credit for stopping eight wars. The hot mic caught him referring to the Nobel snub as well as reiterating his claims about stopping the Indo-Pak conflict earlier this year.

title: 'I solved 8 wars, how about India and Pakistan': Trump repeats claims on hot mic
